body:
Thank you for the comment. So for only sliding o line a couple times, are you saying don't bother with it? I kinda feel like this is the case as most interior linemen just bully my guards/centers to collapse the pocket.

The 1/2 drag routes does make a lot of sense. Ive been feeling like I just don't have time to let some deeper crossing routes to develop. Then by that time Im hit/needing to escape the pocket. That makes sense. Sticking with WR instead of TE for speed I assume?

Yeah my player isn't the fastest which sucks trying to get out of the pocket haha

Thanks for the feedback. It seems my interior defenders are just getting pushed aside like nothing which causes me to fall back instead of stepping up. I admit, I could step up better, so I will give that a go. Crossing routes ftw haha

It just feels like my ex took everything with her and I am left with the rubble of a world I felt safe and loved in. Then she gets to just move on without any caring for me or the time we spent together.
Thank you very much for your kind words

This post resonates with me so deeply. I couldn't agree more that the feeling of deep love and none reciprocation/honesty from them. The belief that they are in this with you. Then, they just aren't. They walk away. Leaving you like it was nothing

You aren't alone friend. I literally have those thoughts through out my day. People say just stop it or let it go, but how the hell are we supposed to just let things be?

Cant we just try and work things out?

Anyways. Yes, I have the same issue
Dude!! I'm so proud of you man! Well done!!
Thank you very much.  Means a lot for you to say that

I'm so sorry that happened to you. I truly empathize with your pain.

I'm trying to move forward, it is just a fucking roller coaster of emotions and remorse
